title: Repository workspace
description: Connect a Git account, pick repositories and choose the branches to index.

connections.title: Connections
connections.empty: No connection yet. Add a connection to browse repositories.
connections.loadError: The connections could not be loaded.
connections.maintainerOnly: Only the creator or an administrator can change this connection. You can still use it.
connections.existing: This account already had a connection. It is reused.
connections.deleteBody: Repositories that already use the connection block the deletion. The provider account is not changed.
connections.disabledNote: This connection is disabled. Existing documentation stays available. Browsing and indexing need the connection to be enabled.

dialog.description: The token is encrypted on the server and is never shown again.
dialog.serverUrlHint: An HTTPS address, for example https://git.example.com
dialog.tokenNewHint: Use a personal access token with read access to repositories.
dialog.tokenSaved: A token is saved. Leave this field empty to keep it, or enter a new token to replace it.

catalog.title: Repositories
catalog.scopeNote: Search, access and sort apply to all repositories available through this connection.
catalog.error: The repositories could not be loaded.
catalog.noConnection: Select a connection to browse its repositories.
catalog.disabled: This connection is disabled, so repositories cannot be browsed.

plan.title: Index plan
plan.noRepository: Select a repository to plan its indexing.
plan.providerNote: Nothing changes on the Git provider.
plan.disabledReason: The connection is disabled. Enable it to index branches.
plan.lookup: Checking whether the repository is indexed
plan.lookupError: The index state could not be checked.
plan.generateSkillHelp: Adds a SKILL.md descriptor to the exported documentation. It applies when the repository is first indexed.

managed.error: The indexed branches could not be loaded.
managed.disabledReason: The connection is disabled, so sync and rebuild are unavailable.
managed.removeTitle: Remove this branch from the index?
managed.removeBody: Only the OpenDeepWiki data of {branch} is deleted. The branch on the Git provider is not changed.

errors.notFound: The item does not exist or you cannot see it.
errors.maintenanceForbidden: Only the creator or an administrator can change this connection.
errors.connectionInUse: Repositories still use this connection, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this item at the same time. Reload and try again.
errors.accountMismatch: The token belongs to a different provider account.
errors.secretUnreadable: The stored token cannot be read. Enter a new token.
errors.invalidToken: The token is missing or not valid.
errors.invalidDisplayName: The display name is not valid.
errors.serverUrlInvalid: The server URL must be an HTTPS address.
errors.serverUrlBlocked: The server address is not allowed.
errors.providerRejected: The provider rejected the token. Enter a valid token.
errors.providerForbidden: The token has no permission for this request.
errors.providerNotFound: The provider did not find the resource.
errors.providerUnavailable: The provider request failed. Try again later.
errors.rateLimited: The provider rate limit is reached. Try again later.
errors.timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
errors.invalidBranchName: A branch name is not valid.
errors.remoteBranchNotFound: A selected branch does not exist on the provider.
errors.remoteBranchLookupLimit: The repository has too many branches to check the selection.
errors.repositoryNotFound: The repository does not exist or you cannot see it.
errors.branchJobActive: A job of this branch is running. Try again when it has finished.
errors.generationActive: The repository is being generated. Try again later.
errors.legacyCredentials: Account and password fields are no longer accepted. Use a Git connection.
errors.urlCredentials: The Git URL must not contain a user name or password.
errors.hostMismatch: The connection belongs to another Git server than the repository.
errors.alreadyConnected: The repository is already connected through another connection.
